messages.subject: a problema running models in Wallace
parts:

> library (wallace)
Loading required package: shiny
Loading required package: leaflet
> wallace :: run_wallace ()

Loading required package: rJava

  102: vars_rename_eval
  101: tidyselect :: vars_rename
  100: rename.data.frame
   98: function_list [[k]]
   96: freduce
   95: _fseq
   94: eval
   93: eval
   91:%>%
   90: <reactive> [modules / mod_c6_maxent.R # 81]
   74: mod.maxent
   73: noteEventHandler [C: \ Users \ Daily \ Documents \ R \ win-library \ 3.4 \ wallace \ shiny / server.R # 503]

Please, if someone can help us I would appreciate it very much
Thank you

messages.author: d73691b565754184
messages.subject: Re: a problema running models in Wallace
parts:
Hi Daryl,

We are working on this issue. We need to make some changes in Wallace to work with the new version of the ENMeval package (more info). A temporary solution is installing the oldest version of ENMeval.

> devtools::install_github("bobmuscarella/ENM...@Version-0.2.2")

Please, let me know if this temporary solution works for you.

Best,
Gonzalo

messages.subject: Re: a problema running models in Wallace
parts:
Hi Daryl,

Good to know that you can run Wallace now. FYI, you can also use the following code:
> devtools::install_version("ENMeval", version ="0.2.2", repos = "http://cran.us.r-project.org")

I will let you know when the new version of Wallace (1.0.6) is available on CRAN.

Best,
Gonzalo
